section.title: Introduction
section.simpara: Papillon Journey is an online JRPG and a training platform where players sharpen their systems and software engineering skills through quests, challenges, mini-games, and immersive storylines.
This document presents our vision for the project: what it is, why it matters, and how we intend to make it succeed.

section.title: Purpose
section.simpara: Formal and model-driven approaches to software development emerged in the 1960s–1980s through close collaboration between academia and industries operating under extreme safety and reliability demands — the earliest being defence, aerospace, nuclear power, and railway signalling. Their use broadened during the 1990s–2000s to other life-critical (automotive, medical devices) and high-stakes domains (finance, hardware design). They are now gradually entering mainstream software engineering, finding applications in cloud infrastructure, telecommunications, blockchain, and cybersecurity.
Papillon Journey seizes this momentum and tackles three persistent barriers to broader adoption:

listitem.simpara: Limited exposure. The historical confinement of these approaches to high-assurance niches has unintentionally reinforced the misconception that they are irrelevant to the daily concerns of most software professionals. Demonstrating their power through large-scale, open-source initiatives in web, mobile, and game development will help dispel this view. That is why Papillon Journey will be cross-platform — playable directly in a web browser or via native applications on smartphones, tablets, and PCs.

Fragmented tooling. Companies favour tools that integrate smoothly into existing workflows. Those supporting formal methods — narrowly specialised and rarely interoperable — often fail to do so. Chrysal Studio, the research subproject of Papillon Journey, will explore and prototype an integrated engineering environment to change that. We will start building with the patchwork of disjointed tools available today, transitioning progressively to Chrysal Studio, until it can fully sustain both itself and the game.

Inverted pedagogy. Children learn to add and multiply long before they ever hear of ring theory — and only if they choose to. Yet formal modelling is typically taught the other way around: heavy on theory, light on practice, and illustrated with simplistic ‘toy examples’ that bear little resemblance to the challenges encountered in industry. Fusing the experience of a JRPG (for example, Final Fantasy) with that of a training platform (such as Coursera) without breaking immersion is no small feat. One thing is certain, though: learners will spend most of their time practising. The very nature of JRPGs will steer us away from the pitfall of inverted pedagogy.

section.simpara: For Papillon Journey to be a living example of what it teaches, it must be libre: open for study, contribution, and adaptation, provided derivatives remain libre. Not only because we value freedom, but also to raise the visibility of formal modelling techniques — through a transparent, participatory, and engaging real-world use case accessible across various devices.

section.title: Stakeholders and value propositions
section.simpara: Value propositions evolve alongside the people they serve. As their goals, challenges, and expectations shift, some facets are reinvented and others phased out. Even so, certain core needs persist — and it is these that keep a project relevant over time. Below, we outline those that matter most to our stakeholders and map them to value propositions. For a deeper dive, see papillon-docs-β.

section.title: Video game players
section.simpara:
Training is future-oriented: the time and effort invested in it aim to unlock later payoffs — a job, promotion, career pivot, or proficiency. There is no such thing as training for the sake of it. The appeal of gaming, on the other hand, is precisely a break from that logic. Players expect games to provide a brief window in their day through which they can throw out all future concerns and fully enjoy the present moment. An experience that fails to honour this misses the whole point.
This is why Papillon Journey will be, above all, fun.

It will be a play-anywhere-anytime game by design. The web version will render 2D isometric visuals with vector-based, hand-drawn art that looks great and performs beautifully on everything from smartphones to desktops. Where hardware permits, native editions on Windows, Android, iOS/iPadOS, and HarmonyOS will elevate the experience with enhanced 2.5D graphics, richer lighting, and added depth. Progress will synchronise across all platforms, so players can switch between devices.

Using in-game systems such as courier services or trading posts, players will be able to share resources, discoveries, and hard-won strategies whenever it suits them, without needing to be online at the same time.
Certain locations and NPCs will also offer mini-games in which they can compete live. These multiplayer features will feel like a part of the world rather than something bolted on.

As the player base expands, Papillon Journey will pursue partnerships with renowned game franchises and studios to create crossover content. Such scope-limited collaborations will reconnect players with characters and stories they already love while they learn formal engineering.

section.title: Software engineering learners
section.simpara: The initial training of a software engineer reaches a satisfying end once they have the skills to turn software ideas into working, maintainable systems. Teamwork is one of them, as most systems are built through collaborative effort. Continuing education then becomes a pursuit of mastery and specialisation.
Papillon Journey will support both stages of the learners’ journey in two mutually reinforcing ways:

listitem.simpara: The fundamentals will be woven into the gameplay, so learners build skills through playful practice of project and product management, UX design, specification, development, verification, and validation. As they advance the story, the levelling up of their characters will mirror their own progress, with the climactic endgame posing the ultimate challenge to their training.

For learners eager to apply lessons learned in-game to real-world scenarios, the project’s libre codebase will serve as an expansive playground for deeper mastery. The comprehensive and high-quality documentation will empower them to study, contribute to, and adapt it with confidence. Dedicated community channels will foster support, collaboration, and knowledge sharing, ensuring no one navigates this journey alone.

section.simpara: We never truly know something until we teach it to someone else. Papillon Journey will provide a mod development framework that enables players to upskill one another. It will facilitate the creation of custom downloadable content (DLC) that transforms visuals, alters game mechanics, introduces new quests, tells new stories, and covers additional training topics. By officially embracing modding, we will motivate learners to dive into the source code and practise formal engineering in earnest.
